name: staff-profile-enum-contract
title: Fix staff profile GraphQL enum serialization
description: Restore the manager staff list by aligning lowercase staff persistence enums with the uppercase GraphQL contract at the shared resolver boundary.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The reported manager staff-list failure is caused by missing GraphQL enum internal-value mappings. The database and DTO correctly return lowercase values such as monthly, while StaffSalaryType exposes uppercase enum names. Fix the shared resolver contract rather than changing the frontend or stored data.
